limitations: The stored content and browser acceptance data are explicit synthetic fixtures; this does not establish real platform recall, slang coverage or ranking quality.
The production database role must be allowed to create the vector extension before revision 0017 can be deployed to an externally managed PostgreSQL service.
The configured Ollama origin must be reachable from every backend process; this slice does not deploy or supervise Ollama and does not download a model.
One full knowledge version is one chunk in this MVP; long-document chunking, background retries, HNSW, controlled statistics and cited Q&A remain later slices.
The existing MinIO instance, platform authorization, real source ingestion and seven-day continuous operation are outside this evidence.
